source_title: In Which Currency Will My Commission Be Paid
snippet_primary: "If you don't live or pay taxes in Brazil, you can withdraw your balance directly to your local bank account in the currency of your country (as long as it is US Dollars, Euros, or Pounds)."
subject_exact: Hotmart allows non-Brazil creators to withdraw commissions to local bank accounts — restricted to USD, EUR, or GBP only
local_qualifiers: don't live or pay taxes in Brazil
withdraw your balance directly to your local bank account in the currency of your country
as long as it is US Dollars, Euros, or Pounds
parser_notes: Hotmart help center (accessed April 14, 2026). Non-Brazil creators: local bank account withdrawals restricted to USD, EUR, or GBP. Creators in countries with other base currencies must receive one of these three.
